Messages.Author: Arnaud Clavel
Messages.Body:
What happens to a diseased vampire with 1 blood under society of leopold
?
Can his controller choose the order of effects or does he have to deal
with his counter first (because the untap phase starts by untapping the
minions) then burn the vampire (society) because he has no blood left
?

thanks all.

Klav

Messages.Author: Pat Ricochet
Messages.Body:


You must always untap your minions first at the start of your untap
phase (right after you hand back all your Demented Malkavians, at the start
of your turn). You could, of course, burn the vampire in your untap to get
rid of that pesky Antedeluvian Awakening before worrying about that Society
of Leopold, or get the blood from the Hunting Ground first.
All that aside, yeah, you burn.

--
Pat Ricochet
Soul Jar'rn Fool of Atlanta

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
/Arnaud Clavel wrote:
>
> What happens to a diseased vampire with 1 blood under society of leopold
> ?

Assuming you mean Vampiric Disease and not Disease, the vampire victim
has to do two things during the untap phase:

1) Untap (and burn a blood for being infected "when [he] untaps")

This must be done first. [4]

2) Burn a blood or be burned "during the untap phase" for Leopold.

> Can his controller choose the order of effects or does he have to deal
> with his counter first (because the untap phase starts by untapping the
> minions) then burn the vampire (society) because he has no blood left

> ?

The latter.

--

Let me make sure I understand correctly. Effects that occur during the
untap phase can be ordered. Effects that occur when a vampire *untaps*
happen first and cannot be ordered because the untapping is always the first
and non-orderable thing to occur during the untap phase. So a vampire with
Charnas the Imp, 1 blood, and Society of Leopold on it would burn. Right?

Yes, if he was tapped.
